description:
Power BI Desktop is open on the Windows desktop. A CSV file named 'sales_data.csv' is available at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\sales_data.csv. It contains 1000 rows of sales transaction data with columns: Product_ID, Sale_Date, Sales_Rep, Region, Sales_Amount, Quantity_Sold, Product_Category, Unit_Cost, Unit_Price, Customer_Type, Discount, Payment_Method, Sales_Channel.

Your task:
1. In Power BI Desktop, click 'Get Data' and import the file 'sales_data.csv' from C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\.
2. After loading the data, create a Clustered Bar Chart visualization.
3. Set the Y-axis (Category) to 'Region' and the X-axis (Value) to 'Sales_Amount' (Sum).
4. Save the report as 'sales_report.pbix' on the Desktop (C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\).
